entities.summary: The Mosque of Qanibay al-Muhammadi is a mosque located on Al-Saleeba street in Islamic Cairo, Egypt. Completed in 816 AH (1413/1414 CE) during the Burji dynasty era of Mamluk Sultanate, it is located adjacent to the Mosque and Khanqah of Shaykhu.
